# PesaScope — full description

PesaScope turns Safaricom's password-protected "M-PESA Full Statement" PDF into
a spending dashboard, processed entirely in the browser. It is privacy-first by
design: the file is decrypted and parsed on your device with pdf.js, nothing is
uploaded to any server, and nothing persists after the tab closes (aside from
optional local aliases and category corrections you choose to keep, stored only
on your device). No sign-up, no account.

Built by Aevum Labs (https://aevumlabs.site). Free.

## The questions it answers
- Who do I send money to the most — and who sends me money? Ranked people with count, total, average, fees paid and last date; tap a person for every transaction.
- What are my spending habits? Plain-language observations: daily rate, big-spend weekday, late-night payments, typical payment size, most-visited merchant, Fuliza usage, fee burden, regular payees.
- Where does it go? Money grouped by what the payee is — Send money, Received, Buy Goods (Till), PayBill, Bank & cards, Savings & investments, Loans (incl. Timiza/Tala/Zenka-style apps), Fuliza, Insurance, Betting, Airtime & bundles, Cash, Charges.
- Search anything — a name, masked phone, PayBill/till, account or receipt — and get the matching party's summary plus every sent/received row, fees included.
- What did it cost me? Every charge row is linked to the transaction it belongs to (same receipt), so fees are attributable.

## Accuracy
The parser reconciles to the cent against the statement's own SUMMARY totals. If
a figure doesn't add up, it is surfaced rather than guessed.

## Platform
Web only, at https://pesascope.site. Works on modern browsers; the statement is
processed locally, so a private/incognito window is fine.
